CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Normalized table with Id, Col1-Col10, RowState, IsSelectable

Rules.InvariantScript:
Table(
    {
        Id: "",
        Col1: "",
        Col2: "",
        Col3: "",
        Col4: "",
        Col5: "",
        Col6: "",
        Col7: "",
        Col8: "",
        Col9: "",
        Col10: "",
        RowState: "normal",
        IsSelectable: true
    }
)

If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol1, cmp_DataTablePro.Col1Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol2, cmp_DataTablePro.Col2Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol3, cmp_DataTablePro.Col3Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol4, cmp_DataTablePro.Col4Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol5, cmp_DataTablePro.Col5Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol6, cmp_DataTablePro.Col6Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol7, cmp_DataTablePro.Col7Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol8, cmp_DataTablePro.Col8Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol9, cmp_DataTablePro.Col9Width, 0) + If(cmp_DataTablePro.ShowCol10, cmp_DataTablePro.Col10Width, 0)

If(
    ThisItem.Id = varDTP_SelectedId,
    ColorValue("#EFF6FF"),
    If(
        Lower(ThisItem.RowState) = "warning",
        ColorValue("#FFF7ED"),
        If(
            Lower(ThisItem.RowState) = "error" || Lower(ThisItem.RowState) = "danger",
            ColorValue("#FEF2F2"),
            If(ThisItem.IsSelected, cmp_DataTablePro.SurfaceAltColor, cmp_DataTablePro.BackgroundColor)
        )
    )
)

If(
    cmp_DataTablePro.IsLoading,
    cmp_DataTablePro.LoadingText,
    If(
        cmp_DataTablePro.IsError,
        cmp_DataTablePro.ErrorText,
        cmp_DataTablePro.EmptyText
    )
)
